title: Guide to the Corpus Christi Oyster & Seafood Festival - NewsBreak
text:
By Jacqueline Gonzalez ,
9 hours ago 10:00 a.m. - 10:00 p.m. 8401 South Padre Island Dr. Ample parking available at Peary Place Park. Rideshare drop-off available. Come hungry because seafood is at the center of the weekend. Texas Gulf oysters take the spotlight with options including raw oysters on the half shell, grilled oysters, and Oysters Rockefeller. Festivalgoers can also dig into Gulf shrimp, snow crab legs, fish tacos, jambalaya, seafood gumbo, and other Gulf Coast favorites. And it’s not all seafood. With more than 40 vendors throughout the festival grounds, you’ll also find barbecue and grilled dishes, corn on the cob, desserts, sweets, and vegetarian and kids’ menu options. Wash it all down with craft beer, frozen margaritas, fresh lemonade, specialty cocktails, and more. Read full article
